title: Four AI

listing.shortDescription: A full-stack platform for AI voice generation, text-to-speech, voice changing and image generation — React and Vite frontend, serverless API and PostgreSQL.
listing.fullDescription: Four AI is a complete AI content platform. Users generate natural-sounding speech from text, convert text to speech in multiple voices and languages, apply studio effects to uploaded audio, and create images from prompts with Hugging Face FLUX.1 models. Accounts, profiles, usage history, a voice library and an admin panel with ban/unban complete the product loop.

cover.imageAlt: Four AI — AI Voice & Image Generation Platform

closing.clientOverview: Personal project — full-stack AI product built end to end
closing.conclusion: Four AI ships as a working product: users can generate speech, change voices, and create images from prompts, with accounts, usage history, and admin moderation — all behind a polished glassmorphic UI.

features.title: Voice generator
features.description: Natural-sounding speech generated from any text via the Web Speech API.

features.title: Text to speech
features.description: Multiple voices and languages, with language selection per conversion.

features.title: Voice changer
features.description: Robot, echo, reverb, distortion, tremolo and lowpass effects on uploaded audio.

features.title: Image generation
features.description: Text-prompt image generation with Hugging Face FLUX.1 models.

features.title: Accounts & history
features.description: Sign-up, login, password reset, profile management and usage tracking.

features.title: Admin moderation
features.description: Admin login via environment password with user list and ban/unban.

challenge.summary: Building AI tools is one thing; packaging them as a product is another. The platform needed accounts, usage tracking and moderation alongside genuinely useful generation tools.

points.title: Model wiring
points.description: Voice, TTS and image models each needed clean integration and error handling.

points.title: User management
points.description: Sign-up, login, password reset and profile management end to end.

points.title: Moderation
points.description: Admins needed visibility into users and the power to ban.

points.title: Smooth UI
points.description: Generation tools had to feel instant, with glassmorphic polish.

solution.summary: Four tools, one product. Each generator got a dedicated studio screen, and the account system wraps them into a single product with history and moderation.

points.title: Dedicated studios
points.description: Separate screens for voice, TTS, voice change and image generation.

points.title: FLUX image engine
points.description: Hugging Face FLUX.1 models generate images from text prompts.

points.title: Full account loop
points.description: Auth, profiles, settings and per-user usage history.

points.title: Admin panel
points.description: Environment-gated admin login with ban and unban controls.
